get.summary: Every book in the shared library with owners, my Kobo and my reading progress

put.summary: Add a library book to my library, or undo removing it. Cancels a pending deletion.

delete.summary: Remove a book from my library and my Kobo. When nobody owns it any more it is deleted after 7 days.

get.summary: Every reader's Kobo and whether this library book is on it

put.summary: Put the book on a reader's Kobo shelf; that reader becomes an owner. Idempotent.

delete.summary: Take the book off a reader's Kobo shelf. The book stays in the library. Idempotent.
